title: Ethertweaks
description:
A add-on datapack for Etherology 0.1.5
Adds new recipes and a tutorial book.
body:
An add-on datapack for Etherology v0.1.5
- Adds a tutorial book built using the unreleased guidebook that is part of the mod.
  - The book's craftable using Thuja Oil and a Book.
- Adds a few new recipes including an alchemy recipe for the hard to obtain attrahite.

This datapack was made in my spare time and my grammar isn't the best so there may be spelling errors present. Feel free to message me on the official etherology discord about any issues or suggestions.
